title: phase-qx: isolated document delivery service
description:
## Goal
Plan a small document delivery service with an API, a worker, and a user-facing boundary.
## Does Not Close
Production deployment.
design: The API accepts delivery requests; a worker processes them. A boundary adapter integrates the service.
acceptance_criteria: The planned sprints can be reviewed independently and integrated on the phase branch.
